notes:
ScreenTale 1.17.0 makes it safer to edit a recording and lets you export just the part you need.

- Reset to Original in the Editor's project menu removes every edit and brings back the full recording. Your recorded media was never changed by editing or Save, so a Save you did not mean to make no longer leaves you stuck with those edits. Undo brings them back until you save again.
- Save As is now available from the File menu and with Shift-Command-S, so you can keep several edited versions of a recording.
- Select clips on the Timeline, open Export and choose Selected clips under Range to export only that part. The save dialog now suggests your project's name.
- With an active license or trial, the Export sheet now shows Export Video instead of Export with Watermark.
- A renamed project now keeps its new name in Library after you switch to another recording.
